candidates.title: Beyond the price per token: Choosing the right OpenAI model on Amazon Bedrock for your workload
candidates.summary: Comparing models on dollars per million tokens misses what production workloads actually pay for: outcomes. This post shares an open-source benchmarking harness that measures cost per correct answer, agent trajectory cost, and rubric-graded deliverable quality across OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock.

candidates.title: Build interactive MCP Apps using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Learn how to build and deploy an MCP App with interactive HTML widgets on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Because MCP Apps is a host-agnostic standard, the same server delivers the same rich experience across AI hosts like ChatGPT and Claude that support the extension.

candidates.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
candidates.summary: Tan wants smaller, American open-weight AI labs to use the same kind of training techniques on American frontier AI labs, giving the U.S. a more robust set of open-weight options that aren’t Chinese.

candidates.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
candidates.summary: Twenty-five leading mathematicians signed an open letter arguing that AI labs are threatening their intellectual work.

candidates.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
candidates.summary: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
